answer.reason: The verses tell of the palace's building over thirteen years, its finishing, and its fittings, so a short line can state what was done and what happened with it.

clauses.english: was built by Solomon over thirteen years until he finished all his house
clauses.quote: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

clauses.english: included the house of the forest of Lebanon, built on rows of cedar pillars
clauses.quote: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon

doubts: 1KI 3:1 and 9:1 mention the house only in passing, so they were not cited.
2CH 2:1 and 2CH 2:12 speak of a house for his kingdom, which may mean the royal house, so they were left out.
